start.text: Hello? You went to the park? Good, good. Alone? ... Okay, okay, I'm not asking.

news.text: Listen. The news here is saying something about Bangalore. Some fever, north side, Hebbal or where. Be careful. Don't go in crowds. Don't eat outside.

adult.text: Yes, yes, you are an adult. Adults also get fever. Drink hot water. Call Sunday. ... And send the photo of the room, you said you would.

quiet.text: (The call ends. On the phone, Reels is still open: a doctor's thread, a meme, a clip of a Hebbal ward with the lights off. You put it face down and lie on the cot.)
